dct_description_sm: To determine the concentrations of contaminants in narwhal blubber and muscle tissues collected by Nunavut hunters. Measured contaminants included, polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) and organochlorine (OC) pesticides (measured at McGill University), as well as total mercury, mercury isotopes, and per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) (measured at Aarhus University). Blubber extracts are also screened for emerging contaminants using non-target approaches. The data are provided to Nunavut communities that are interested in having more information on current contaminant contaminant concentrations and trends for this species, and will also be available for national (Northern Contaminants Program) and international (Arctic Monitoring and Assessment Programme) monitoring and assessment programs and reports.
